extracted.name: Kuih Cara berlauk (muffin with minced beef curry) non keto
extracted.description: Common tea time snack found in Singapore, malaysia and some part of indonesia
ingredient_lines: 5 tablespoon olive oil for frying the filling
instruction_lines: Filling Heat oil....combine curry powder, onion,ginger and garlic to form a paste Once oil is hot, fry the paste and add minced beef..add salt and once fully cooked..add in coriander leaves and stir.
The batter Combine flour, coconut milk,water,turmeric, eggs and salt Mix well.
Spray muffin tray with olive oil spray Pour batter half full..add in filling...add chillies and fried shallots
Baked for 20 minute in a 190 degrees..or until its fully cooked!
